title: Self-hosting source catalogue and SSC corroboration
summary: The Builder scans its own shipped .cls tree and exposes classes/methods/attributes/constants/requires/options through relocation-stable logical paths. Semantic Source Control is optional corroborating evidence, not a runtime dependency.
invariants: Source item identity is logical path, not basename or build-machine absolute path.
SOURCE.OPEN is a real semantic action projecting authoritative source detail.
The Builder must work independently of consumer projects.
